Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_date DATE:=to_date(:global.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 v_local_date date;
BEGIN
 v_local_date:=lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 
 if :valid_list_types.eff_date > :valid_list_types.term_date then
 show_error('1316');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status in ('QUERY' ,'CHANGED') then
 if v_date !=:valid_list_types.eff_date then
 if v_date < trunc(v_local_date) then
 show_error('8055');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 elsif :system.record_status in ('INSERT') then
 if :valid_list_types.eff_date < trunc(v_local_date) then
 show_error('12011');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

PROCEDURE enable_disable(pl_mode in varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.show_term');
 --item_change('ctrl_blk_1.s_enlistment_type',pl_mode);
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.list_type',pl_mode); 
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.pb_retrieve',pl_mode);

 --item_change('ctrl_blk_1.show_term',pl_mode);
 
 if pl_mode='D' then

 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_list_type',enabled,property_false);
 item_change('toolbar.COMMIT_FORM','E');
 else

 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_list_type',enabled,property_true);
 item_change('toolbar.COMMIT_FORM','D');
 end if;
 
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_check IS
 check_dup number;
 temp number;

BEGIN
 
/* Check in the database */

if nvl(:global.enlistment_type,' ') != nvl(:valid_list_types.enlistment_type,' ') or
 nvl(:global.list_type,' ') != nvl(:valid_list_types.list_type,' ') then
 

 select count(*) into temp from valid_list_types where
 enlistment_type= :valid_list_types.enlistment_type and list_type=:valid_list_types.list_type;

 if temp > 0 then
 show_error('16106');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;


/* check in the buffer */


 IF nvl(:global.enlistment_type,' ') != nvl(:valid_list_types.enlistment_type,' ') or
 nvl(:global.list_type,' ') != nvl(:valid_list_types.list_type,' ') then
 
 check_insert_rg('enlist_rg0','C05C05',:global.enlistment_type||','
 ||:global.list_type||',','D',check_dup); 
 END IF;

 check_insert_rg('enlist_rg0','C05C05',:valid_list_types.enlistment_type||','
 ||:valid_list_types.list_type||',','C',check_dup);

 if check_dup = 1 then
 show_error('16106');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 check_insert_rg('enlist_rg0','C05C05',:valid_list_types.enlistment_type||','
 ||:valid_list_types.list_type||',','U',check_dup);
 
 end if;

END;
